response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) as share FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind;
